annotation.interpretation_a: An endpoint can choose to enforce a lower limit than advertised, even if it could handle the advertised limit.
annotation.interpretation_b: An endpoint is permitted to enforce a lower limit than advertised, but is not required to do so.
annotation.justification: The use of "MAY" creates ambiguity. It is unclear whether the endpoint *can* enforce a lower limit, or whether it *is permitted* to enforce a lower limit. This affects implementation because it determines whether an endpoint must be prepared to handle requests up to the advertised limit, or whether it can always limit them to a lower value.
